diet.intro: Some general nutrition references — not a personalized plan.
tips: Prioritize lean protein (chicken, fish, eggs, legumes) at each main meal.
Include complex carb sources (brown rice, oats, sweet potato) for training energy.
Eat a variety of vegetables and fruit throughout the day for fiber and micronutrients.
Drink water steadily — don't wait until you're thirsty to hydrate.
Pay attention to portions rather than cutting out entire food groups.
diet.disclaimer: This is general and educational. For a personalized meal plan, talk to a registered dietitian.
